To the rider: your complaint about the arrival marker is factually correct, and it is recorded against the driver — but it does not refund your S$4.50 fee. Under POL-NS-05 that marker is treated as a false arrival marker: it does not start the waiting clock, and the clock is recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 09:41:14. On the recomputed clock the driver held position for 210 seconds, to 09:44:44, against the 180-second free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-02749, platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; cancellation fee S$4.50). That is a 30-second surplus, not a shortfall, so POL-NS-05(iii) applies: the false marker does not by itself defeat the fee, POL-NS-01 governs and is satisfied in full — (a) the 'arrived' event exists; (b) on the recomputed clock the driver was in the geofence from 09:41:14, and POL-NS-02 independently finds arrival with 22 consecutive in-radius fixes inside the 25 m accuracy filter; (c) the dwell measured from the first in-geofence fix is 210 s ≥ 180 s, with no longer threshold in force (no_show_threshold_sec is null); (d) the trip was terminated by the driver at 09:44:46 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell elapsed, with no boarding event. POL-NS-06 is not engaged (the same derived block reports shortfall_sec -30, a surplus), and POL-NS-10 gives you nothing because the trip was ended by the driver, not cancelled by you. Your specific arguments: that POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails — limb (b)'s first branch does fail, but its second branch applies, because POL-NS-05 finds the marker false and the clock is recomputed to the first qualifying in-geofence fix, from which limb (b) is read; that the wait timer cannot validate the fee — accepted, the timer that started at 09:39:16 does not validate it, the recomputed 210-second dwell does; that the trip be recorded as a false-arrival event — granted, in the referrals. Even treating the 09:39:14 marker as early and recomputing the clock under POL-NS-05, the gps_trace places the driver inside the geofence at the first qualifying in-geofence fix, 09:41:14, and limb (b) is read from that recomputed clock exactly as it states. kept
    • Limb (c) is satisfied. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds: trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec is 180, and the derived arrival thresholds for this STANDARD zone class record minimum_dwell_sec 180 from POLICY-NO-SHOW; platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies. Measured as the clause requires - from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the arrival tap - the driver's continuous dwell is 210 seconds (09:41:14 to 09:44:44), a margin of 30 seconds over the minimum. kept
    • The accumulated-dwell sub-block of EV-GPS-02749 records shortfall_sec -30.0 on a longest_run_sec basis - a NEGATIVE figure, i.e. the 210 second run exceeds the 180 second period in force and there is a surplus, not a deficit. The only dwell minimum that binds a record carrying platform_policy is the free waiting period under POL-NS-01(c) (fee_schedule.resolution_rule: the retained minimum_dwell_sec table interprets pre-version-2 records only and is never applied to a record that carries platform_policy, as this one does). There is no shortfall, so POL-NS-06's full refund is not licensed. kept
    • The driver's own statement concedes he pressed 'arrived' a bit early, and the derived arrival data agrees: dwell_start_offset_sec is -120, so the first qualifying in-geofence fix (09:41:14) post-dates the 09:39:14 arrival event. Under POL-NS-05(iii) that does not by itself defeat the fee - where the corrected dwell nonetheless meets the minimum, POL-NS-01 governs and the fee stands - and the corrected dwell here is 210 seconds against 180. POL-NS-05(i) is therefore not reached (no shortfall) and POL-NS-05(ii) is not reached (qualifying in-geofence fixes exist). The record carries no derived fact placing the driver more than 300 m from the pin, or at or above 15 km/h, at the 09:39:14 marker; on the numbers that are on the record, the consequence is a false-arrival referral for driver education, not a refund. kept
    • Limb (d) is satisfied. The trip record shows no boarding event and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 09:44:46 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW - one of the three codes the limb recognises - two seconds after the last qualifying in-geofence fix at 09:44:44, that is, at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed. The driver did not cancel under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, so the in-radius admission route to FULL_REFUND is not open. kept
    • POL-NS-03 does not apply and the rider cannot route this to a wrong-entrance outcome. That clause's premise is stationary fixes OUTSIDE the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; the driver's qualifying run lies INSIDE the 50 m radius (the trace's minimum recorded distance to the pin is 0.11 m), so POL-NS-02 is satisfied and this clause yields to it. In any event trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill of POL-NS-03(ii) is unavailable and no platform-funded payment arises on those facts. kept
    • POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. Limb (a) requires a locating or coordinating message FROM THE RIDER during the waiting window; the chat log holds exactly one message and it was sent by the DRIVER at 09:39:34 ('im at the pickup point'), delivered at 09:39:35 and read by the rider at 09:40:04 - an unanswered coordination attempt by the driver, not by the rider. Limb (a) fails, so the rider-exonerating clause does not apply. kept
    • Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is in any event affirmatively failed on the rider's own admissible fixes - this is not an 'undecidable rider presence' case under POL-NS-11. The rider track contains 63 fixes across the waiting window, every recorded speed is 0.0 km/h, and the rider's distance to the pickup pin ranges only between 633.97 m and 639.97 m, with a qualifying (within 100 m STANDARD rider presence radius) fix count of zero. The rider's device was roughly 637 m from the pin, stationary, for the whole window. kept
    • POL-NS-10 gives the rider nothing here. Its grace limbs (a) and (b) and its limb (f) all govern a cancellation BY THE RIDER, whereas this trip was terminated by the driver with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, so no grace period was exceeded and no limb (f) exception can be shown. No waiting-time fee was charged either (fare_breakdown.waiting_time_fee is 0.00, and limb (d) permits a waiting-time fee only on a completed trip), so there is no line to refund under limb (e). kept
    • All four limbs of POL-NS-01 holding and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing them, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the cancellation fee in force: 80 percent of SGD 4.50 is SGD 3.60, the figure the fare_breakdown money block itself computes as driver_compensation under POL-NS-07 from the net platform_policy figure. The anti-farming check does not trip - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the first limb requires, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (75) is 0.013, below the 0.08 the second limb requires - so compensation is paid, not withheld. kept
    • The outcome this record produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd SGD 3.60, mirroring driver_compensation_sgd, and the fee itself stands. Under POL-GEN-03 the sentence in POL-NS-07 that the ruling on the fee is NO_ACTION describes the disposition of the CHARGE, not the value of the ruling field, and where compensation is paid the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION. The rider's claim therefore fails: fare_breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the present state the rider asks to change is left as it is. kept
    • No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires, so this case is decidable without human review. Limb (d): driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (anti-farming check does not trip) and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so neither branch of limb (d) is met. Limb (c): rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so no repeat-pairing pattern exists. Limb (b): no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence - the trip record, the trace and the chat log agree. kept
    • The evidence carrying the driver's deciding facts is clean, so no discount and no confidence cap applies under POL-GEN-02(2). EV-GPS-02749 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 100 percent coverage, a 10 second cadence, an empty gaps list and max_gap_sec 0.0, so POL-NS-08(b) is not engaged; the 09:39:14 arrival event falls exactly on the trace's cadence grid (first fix 09:30:14, interval 10 s, 540 seconds apart), so the 90 second clock-skew test of POL-NS-08(a) is not engaged. EV-TRIP-02749, EV-CHAT-02749 and EV-FARE-02749 are each COMPLETE at weight 1.0, and the fare_breakdown cancellation-fee line (SGD 4.50) reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. The only sub-1.0 artifact in the bundle is EV-ADVIS-02749-01 (TRAFFIC_ADVISORY, MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0); the driver's case does not rely on it and does not assert POL-NS-06(i) against it. kept
